statement: A release version bump must also update the exact-version pins in plugin/.mcp.json and server.json — package.json alone is not the version
rationale: v1.12.0 release gate failed on its first run because npm version only touched package.json; plugin/.mcp.json ("hunch-exact@npm:@davesheffer/hunch@X") and server.json (MCP registry manifest, two version fields) still pinned 1.11.0. The gate's version test (test/version.test.ts) catches it, but only after a full ~25-minute run — the rule belongs at edit time.
